name: Chang Hu
bio: Chang Hu lived in the 9th century AD.
The poems here are Witter Bynner’s versions, from the texts of Kiang Kang-hu, in The Jade Mountain (1929).

poems.title: She Sings an Old Song
poems.author: Chang Hu
poems.translator: trans. Witter Bynner and Kiang Kang-hu (1929)
poems.text:
A lady of the palace these twenty years,
She has lived here a thousand miles from her home —
Yet ask her for this song and, with the first few words of it,
See how she tries to hold back her tears.

poems.title: On the Terrace of Assembled Angels
poems.author: Chang Hu
poems.translator: trans. Witter Bynner and Kiang Kang-hu (1929)
poems.text:
I
The sun has gone slanting over a lordly roof
And red-blossoming branches have leaned toward the dew
Since the Emperor last night summoned a new favourite
And Lady Yang’s bright smile came through the curtains.

II
The Emperor has sent for Lady Kuo Kuo.
In the morning, riding toward the palace-gate,
Disdainful of the paint that might have marred her beauty,
To meet him she smooths her two moth-tiny eyebrows.

poems.title: Of One in the Forbidden City
poems.author: Chang Hu
poems.translator: trans. Witter Bynner and Kiang Kang-hu (1929)
poems.text:
When the moonlight, reaching a tree by the gate,
Shows her a quiet bird on its nest,
She removes her jade hairpins and sits in the shadow
And puts out a flame where a moth was flying.

poems.title: At Nan-king Ferry
poems.author: Chang Hu
poems.translator: trans. Witter Bynner and Kiang Kang-hu (1929)
poems.text:
This one-story inn at Nan-king ferry
Is a miserable lodging-place for the night —
But across the dead moon’s ebbing tide,
Lights from Kua-chou beckon on the river.

poems.title: 宮詞二首·其一 (Gong ci er shou, qi yi)
poems.author: Chang Hu
poems.collection: 唐詩三百首 (Three Hundred Tang Poems)
poems.text:
故國三千里，深宮二十年。
一聲何滿子，雙淚落君前。

poems.title: 題金陵渡 (Ti jin ling du)
poems.author: Chang Hu
poems.collection: 唐詩三百首 (Three Hundred Tang Poems)
poems.text:
金陵津渡小山樓，一宿行人自可愁。
潮落夜江斜月裏，兩三星火是瓜州。

poems.title: 贈內人 (Zeng nei ren)
poems.author: Chang Hu
poems.collection: 唐詩三百首 (Three Hundred Tang Poems)
poems.text:
禁門宮樹月痕過，媚眼惟看宿鷺窠。
斜拔玉釵燈影畔，剔開紅焰救飛蛾。

poems.title: 集靈臺·其一 (Ji ling tai, qi yi)
poems.author: Chang Hu
poems.collection: 唐詩三百首 (Three Hundred Tang Poems)
poems.text:
日光斜照集靈臺，紅樹花迎曉露開。
昨夜上皇新授籙，太真含笑入簾來。

poems.title: 集靈臺·其二 (Ji ling tai, qi er)
poems.author: Chang Hu
poems.collection: 唐詩三百首 (Three Hundred Tang Poems)
poems.text:
虢國夫人承主恩，平明騎馬入宮門。
卻嫌脂粉污顏色，淡掃蛾眉朝至尊。
